one_line_description.value: Airtable is a structured data platform whose field types, relational links, and built-in automations make it a rich data layer for AI agents and external systems.
one_line_description.quote: Airtable's structured field types, relational links, and built-in automations make it a rich data layer for AI agents.

has_public_api.quote: This is the reference for the Airtable API. Use the sidebar to explore the API and learn about important concepts.

api_type.quote: The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.

api_breadth.value: REST, read-write: records plus base/table/view management and enterprise admin APIs (users, share links, audit logs)
api_breadth.quote: The Enterprise API allows teams to manage their account programmatically outside of the Admin panel UI through actions like managing users, updating access permissions, and managing bases, tables, and views.

docs_url.quote: This is the reference for the Airtable API.

auth_methods.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: See the Scopes reference for a full list of possible scopes.

access_model.quote: Free Access to all "Base Data" endpoints except "Views" Public API limit is enforced.

access_notes.value: No sales contact or review: the free plan is self-serve with 1,000 API calls/month and the Team plan with 100,000/month; Enterprise API endpoints additionally require an Enterprise Scale workspace and their docs are only visible when logged into such an account.
access_notes.quote: Free plan: 1000 API calls per month - Team plan: 100000 API calls per month

rate_limits.value: 5 requests per second per base (all plans); 50 requests per second for all traffic using personal access tokens from a given user or service account; monthly 1,000 calls (Free) and 100,000 calls (Team)
rate_limits.quote: Airtable enforces a rate limit of 5 requests per second (per base) to ensure optimal user performance across all pricing tiers.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Legacy API keys were fully deprecated on 2024-02-01, requiring migration to personal access tokens or OAuth access tokens; no API version number scheme was described in the retrieved pages.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: As of February 1st 2024, the deprecation period for Airtable API keys has ended.

verdict_reason: Airtable publishes a full public REST API reference and self-serve authentication via personal access tokens or OAuth, with free-plan API access capped at 1,000 calls/month. The official MCP server at mcp.airtable.com/mcp is available on all plans, and the Composio catalog already contains a 26-tool Airtable toolkit. Only enterprise admin endpoints require an Enterprise Scale plan.
open_questions: Webhooks: Airtable's Webhooks API appeared in search snippets (e.g., https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/webhooks-overview) but that page's text was not included in the SOURCES bundle, so webhooks is recorded as not_found.
Sandbox/test environment: only support-article snippets mentioning an 'app sandbox' were surfaced; no verbatim source text was bundled, so sandbox_or_test_env is not_found.
API versioning scheme: the changelog and deprecation-guidelines pages appeared in search results but their text was not bundled; only the API key deprecation notice was verifiable.
Community MCP servers: GitHub repository and MCP registry searches returned no results in this bundle, so community_mcp_servers is not_found rather than confirmed empty.
Enterprise API endpoint-level detail could not be verified because its documentation is only accessible when logged into an Enterprise Scale workspace.
